candidates.buyer: Small real estate agents, developers and agencies
candidates.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals
candidates.existing: None seen for registration; FIUTT AML duties are K02.
candidates.name: Real estate agent registration pack (Registrar General, 3-year renewal) combined with FIUTT compliance
candidates.trigger: Real Estate Agents Act 2020 (Act 12 of 2020): registration valid 3 years, renewable, with notification of changes; offence to trade unregistered. Commencement is the open question: Parliament's page shows only assent and Gazette dates.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the Act has been proclaimed; registration deadline for existing agents; competitor search not run (budget used).

candidates.buyer: Private members' clubs, betting shop operators and gaming machine owners (about 80 establishments plus 5 casinos per a 2025 trade article)
candidates.existing: Not checked. K06 (gaming tax) was rejected as a one-time portal change; this is a different duty.
candidates.name: Gambling establishment notification and licensing pack (private members' clubs, betting shops, gaming machines)
candidates.trigger: Gambling (Gaming and Betting) Control Act 2021: operators previously under the Liquor Licences Act must notify the Gambling Control Commission, then apply for licences and pay fees once the licensing parts are proclaimed. Legal Notice 700 of 2026 brought s.76 and Schedule 6 into force on 15 Sep 2026; Remote Gambling Order 2026 passed the House 30 Sep 2026.
candidates.unchecked: Whether full licensing is in force and its deadlines; the content of s.76; niche size is small; competitor search not run.

candidates.name: Private security firm licence file and guard roster/training register
candidates.trigger: TTPS licence needs a staff list and training proof; the Private Security Industry Bill (Private Security Service Authority) is on the 2026 agenda. Currently no published renewal cycle or fees.
candidates.unchecked: Number of licensed firms; bill text and passage; whether the guard-register duties are in the bill.

candidates.unchecked: Controlled-drug register rules; whether the CFDD database launched; the renewal cycle in 2026.

candidates.unchecked: Current station count; whether the one-year validity still holds; competitor search not run.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Retail Marketing Licence (RML) under Petroleum Act Ch 62:01 and Petroleum Regulations; licence reportedly valid about 1 year; renewal assessed against Ministry of Energy service-station checklist; needs EMA, Town and Country Planning, Highways approvals and tax clearances; TTBS pump verification every 6 months; LPG storage over 100 imp gal needs Ministry approval; 2016 report said 137 stations with only 1 valid RML. Candidate C05. No current LPG distributor rules found.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Budget used on higher-yield categories; no search run. Cocoa/sugar/rice/flour trade not checked.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Commissioner for Co-operative Development still acts as regulator of credit unions (2025 liquidator appointment in Gazette No. 123 of 2025); the 2005 plan and 2014 Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Bill to move credit union financial supervision to the Central Bank was not confirmed enacted; annual audit by Commissioner or authorised auditor. Candidate C08. Annual-return rules not confirmed.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Private hospitals/nursing homes licensed by Minister under Private Hospitals Act Ch 29:03 (Fire/Life Safety certificate, fee, CMO office). The 2013 accreditation authority bill has no confirmed commencement. CDAP (state drug scheme) has about 289 participating private pharmacies and about 400 private doctors at launch; no source found on lab or doctor claims billing. Medical Board renewal rules not found. Candidates C04, C07.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Pharmacy licences run on a 1 Feb to 31 Jan renewal cycle (Pharmacy Board Regulations, Legal Notice 47 of 2023); about 526 pharmacies, 231 CDAP-authorised in May 2024, later 289; MOH made 84 referrals to police for unregistered products since Jan 2023; CFDD building online product database. Candidates C04, C09. Controlled-drug register rules and precursor users not checked.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Security firms licensed by TTPS (Commissioner of Police discretion); ttconnect lists police certificate, staff list, training proof; no renewal cycle or fees published. Private Security Industry Bill (Private Security Service Authority) has been carried over since 2019 and is on the 2026 legislative agenda, not yet enacted. Candidate C02. Cleaning and manpower agencies not searched.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: No contractor licensing law (Contractors Association still lobbying per Guardian); operative system is Office of the Procurement Regulator Depository prequalification (s.26 PP&DPP Act) plus T&TEC contractor prequalification (7 work groups, 44 classes). Quarry already covered by K04. Candidate C10.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Real Estate Agents Act 2020 (Act 12 of 2020): registration with Registrar General for 3 years, renewable; offence to trade unregistered; Parliament page does not show proclamation (awaiting proclamation per search snippet). Real estate is also an FIUTT listed business (K02). Candidate C01. Notaries not searched.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: No short-term rental registration regime found; Tourism Development Act 2000 called inadequate by Tourism Minister; idea of turning TDC into a regulator with inspection powers (undated); Tobago holds about 48% of Airbnb stock per Guardian; host association discussed. Candidate C06 (weak). Room tax and THA levies not confirmed.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Fisheries Division online export applications (free) require a Ministry of Trade and Industry export licence copy; vessel details needed for tunas, mackerels, marlins, swordfish, sharks, snappers, groupers; Certificate of Eligibility for swordfish and bigeye under Statistical Document Programme; swordfish quotas. EU listing/HACCP not found. Candidate C11. Timber/forest-risk not applicable.

coverage.category: 31. Companies Act beneficial ownership register and annual returns (small private companies)
coverage.found: Act No. 4 of 2024 (in force 23 Sep 2024) sets a 10% threshold and fines of TT$10,000 for some breaches; Registrar notice Oct 2024 on s.93A; amnesty to 31 Jan 2025; about 63,000 companies struck off earlier; TTSEC circular Nov 2025 for reporting entities. Candidate C03. No 2026 deadline found.

coverage.category: 32. Gambling: betting shops, private members' clubs, gaming machines (Gambling (Gaming and Betting) Control Act 2021)
coverage.found: Act partly proclaimed in 2021; Legal Notice 700 of 2026 (Proclamation 11) brings s.76 and Schedule 6 into force 15 Sep 2026; Remote Gambling Order 2026 passed House 30 Sep 2026 and went to the Senate 2 Oct 2026; licensing for clubs and betting shops not confirmed in force; about 5 casinos and 80 gambling establishments. K06 (gaming tax) is a different duty. Candidate C01b.

coverage.category: 33. Customs brokers and commercial importers (Customs Brokers and Customs Clerks Act Ch 78:03)
coverage.found: Commercial imports require a licensed broker; C82 declarations; importer registration number; official sources show a state declaration system, and no 2026 change was found. Candidate C12 (weak).

coverage.category: 34. OSH Act workplace registration and enforcement
coverage.found: OSH Agency enforces the OSH Act 2004; a 2025 Privy Council ruling applies the 6-month limit in s.93 to all prosecutions; no registration deadline found. Candidate C13 (weak, unverified).
Act No. 10 of 2022 sets up a licensing authority (cultivation, processing, retail, import, export, transport); commencement unconfirmed; no licence counts found. Candidate C14 (unverified).

coverage.category: 36. 2026 legislative agenda: Firearms Reform Bill and Miscellaneous Provisions (Alcohol, Cannabis, Dangerous Drugs, Gambling, Tobacco) Bill 2026
coverage.found: Both announced in the 2026 agenda per Guardian; one-line summaries only (stricter firearms control; age limits for sales). No text or dates. Candidate C15 (unverified).

coverage.category: 37. Tobago House of Assembly rules (Tobago-specific tourism/licensing)
coverage.found: No search run on THA-specific rules; only the Tobago share of short-term rental stock was seen under category 29.
